facts.text: Jolene aims to continue working in engineering to create sustainable solutions that benefit communities in need.

evidence.quote: I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions.

facts.text: Jolene feels that her work in engineering has provided her with a sense of purpose and satisfaction.

evidence.quote: Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.

facts.text: Deborah encourages Jolene to stay motivated and focused on her goals, emphasizing the importance of passion and perseverance.

evidence.quote: I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!
Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.
